messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up — ACME asked to move beta for tenant-prefetch to GA in 6 weeks. They want guaranteed <80ms 95th p99 for short prompts and private HSM key support. Need to align runtime/infra/security for scope and launch criteria. Who owns the dependency map?
Adrian (Eng Runtime): Thanks — major items I see: quant variant perf validation, KV cache warmup strategy, and fallback model for cost spikes. We can do perf validation in 2 weeks but need infra for prewarm slots.
Kevin (Infra): Prewarm slots ok but we need capacity commit from product (how many concurrent sessions?) and HSM integration window. HSM requires an infra change + security approval — estimate 3 weeks for infra work once approved.
Maya (Product): ACME expects up to 120 concurrent sessions peak, sustained 40qps. They requested HSM for keys (regulatory). Can we sketch a minimal cut to meet SLAs if HSM is delayed?
Sophia (Security): HSM is blocker for compliance sign-off. Temporary allowed pattern: use KMS + audit wrappers for 30 days maximum per compliance, but legal needs formal exception request. Not ideal.
Lisa (Eng Platform): For routing we can pin ACME to dedicated pool in Dedicated tier; that gets isolation and predictable latency. Platform work: autoscale policy + tenant placement rules. I need 10 workdays to add placement logic and tests.
Chris (Solutions Eng): From customer side: they can tolerate 5% errors during ramp, but not data leakage. Also want a rollback plan to hosted fallback if our Dedicated path has issues.
Adrian (Eng Runtime): Fallback to hosted variant is doable but needs KV cache invalidation strategy. If fallback triggers, we should failover reads-only for some tenants to avoid stale KV state.
sre-bot: Incident runbook template v2 uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-fallback-v2
Maya (Product): OK — proposed risk-reduced rollout plan: week1 perf validation + HSM exception request in parallel; week2 infra prewarm slots + platform placement; week3 staging end-to-end test; week4 canary (5% traffic) then ramp. If HSM not approved by week2, use KMS + audit for canary only. Thoughts?
Kevin (Infra): Timeline seems tight. If infra starts now, we can finish prewarm + HSM wiring by end of week3 if security turns quickly. Biggest unknown: procurement ETA for HSM creds.
Sophia (Security): I'll expedite the compliance review but need the legal exception template from Maya. If we go KMS fallback, I will require extra audit logs and mitigations — I can turn that around in 3 business days.
Lisa (Eng Platform): Canary plumbing ready to receive routing flags. I need exact concurrency numbers for autoscale bump and a feature flag key.
Adrian (Eng Runtime): For KV warmup, propose this simple prewarm script (can run in infra):
```
# prewarm-prefixes.txt contains top-1000 prefixes from customer
for p in $(cat prewarm-prefixes.txt); do
  curl -X POST https://dedicated-host/prefetch -d "{\"prefix\":\"$p\"}" &
done
wait
```
This should reduce first-token latency on canary. We'll add a healthcheck that fails the canary if p99 > 120ms.
Chris (Solutions Eng): I'll coordinate customer data for prewarm prefixes and send them to Adrian by EOD.
Maya (Product): Actions and owners summary: 1) Perf validation (Adrian) — 2w; 2) HSM exception request (Maya/Sophia/legal) — submit today; 3) Infra prewarm + HSM wiring (Kevin) — depends on approval, target end wk3; 4) Platform placement + feature flag (Lisa) — 10d; 5) Canary runbook + rollback (Adrian + Lisa + sRE) — create by staging cutoff.
Maya (Product): Also need a clear launch criteria checklist. Draft below, please thumbs-up if OK or add edits: [ ] p95 < 70ms and p99 < 120ms on canary; [ ] security sign-off or approved KMS exception with audit; [ ] autoscale tested to 150concurrency; [ ] rollback plan validated; [ ] customer acceptance test passed in staging.
Sophia (Security): +1 on checklist if exception route has audit enabled.
Kevin (Infra): +1 but add: infra perf regression <5% token CPU increase during stress.
Adrian (Eng Runtime): +1. I'll own the rollback runbook item.
Lisa (Eng Platform): +1. I'll create the feature-flag and placement PR and link here.
Maya (Product): Great — let's sync tomorrow 11am PT for a quick triage (15m). I will follow up with the legal template and open a short issues board with the owners.
Chris (Solutions Eng): I'll set customer expectations to expect a staged roll and send initial prefix list.
Maya (Product): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
